description_en: Adds one or more rules to a compliance package
description_zh: 将指定规则加入指定合规包
kebab_example: aliyun config attach-config-rule-to-compliance-pack --config-rule-ids cr-6cc4626622af00e70000 --compliance-pack-id cp-5bb1626622af00bd0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachConfigRuleToCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

OperateRuleResult.description_en: The results of the operations to add one or more rules
OperateRuleResult.description_zh: 规则加入合规包的操作结果

OperateRuleItemList.description_en: The result of the operation to add the rule
OperateRuleItemList.description_zh: 规则加入合规包的操作结果列表

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned.

This parameter is empty if the rule is added to the compliance package.
An error code is returned if the rule fails to be added to the compliance package. For more information about error codes, see Error codes (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当规则加入合规包操作成功时，该参数为空。

<props="china">- 当规则加入合规包操作失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)。</props>

<props="intl">- 当规则加入合规包操作失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)。</props>

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
